Team — quick handoff summary for SummitCare (closed today). Keeping this tight so CS can take lead:

Deal highlights
- Contract: SOW v2 attached (key changes: 6-month pilot, 99.5% endpoints SLA for dedicated pool).
- Target go-live window: week of Mar 22 (preferred target: Mar 24).
- Model / infra: Redwood Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pool) — customer requested data isolation.
- Integrations: HL7 export + SFTP for nightly batch ingestion; live API for extraction (see integration section in SOW).
- Data profile: PHI present; customer requires SOC2 + encrypted-at-rest and KMS integration.

Primary asks for CS/Implementation
1) Marissa — primary CS owner. Please confirm discovery kickoff by Mar 11 and own success plan.
2) Dev — implementation lead. Please review network requirements (attached) and call out any blocker for Dedicated deployment.
3) Karthik — escalation & billing contact for any contract/terms questions; he can support procurement cadence.

Attachments: SummitCare_SOW_v2.pdf, launch_readiness_checklist.xlsx, summitcare_network_requirements.png
Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.example/DEAL-2026-1785) and DocuSign for signature.

Next steps (short):
- CS schedules kickoff with SummitCare by Mar 10 (we prefer Mar 11 10am PT).
- Dev to confirm network ports, static IP allowlist, and whether they need a Bastion host by Mar 9.
- Marissa to create initial success metrics (ramp % of traffic, latency targets, rollback criteria).

Thanks Naomi — happy to take point. A few clarifying questions before I schedule the kickoff: 

1) Environment & access
- Confirming this is Redwood Dedicated (single-tenant) — will SummitCare need a private VPC peering or can we use secure public egress with static IPs?
2) Data sensitivity & retention
- You mentioned PHI — do they want default 90-day KV cache retention or full-data retention / custom retention policy? Need to document retention in the success plan.
3) Traffic profile
- Expected concurrency / peak qps for the first 60 days? Are there any hard latency SLAs per API call (99.5% token latency target?)
4) Compliance artifacts
- Has SummitCare already completed the vendor SOC2 questionnaire or should we ask them for the relevant documentation?

I'll draft a kickoff agenda and proposed success metrics once I have answers. Planning to propose Mar 11 at 10am PT for a 60-minute discovery — does that work for folks?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Great questions — answers below (copying SummitCare on the specifics they provided during procurement):

1) Environment & access - Confirmed: Dedicated with public egress + static IP allowlist. SummitCare prefers not to peer at this stage; they'll provide IP ranges for firewall allowlist.
2) Data retention- They asked for encrypted-at-rest and default platform retention to be set to 30 days for caches; full audit logs retained for 12 months. If CS needs longer retention for evaluation we can request an exception from the customer.
3) Traffic profile- Initial expected concurrency: 10-15 rps with 50k tokens/day during pilot. Production estimate (post-pilot): 80-120 rps. Latency target: 95th percentile < 300ms for generation requests; SLA detailed in SOW.
4) Compliance artifacts- SummitCare has a partially completed vendor questionnaire. Jill will share the remaining items (see her note below).

Ownership (finalized)
- CS primary: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — success plan, enablement, ongoing QBRs.
- Implementation lead: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com) — network, deployment, runbook, cutover.
- Billing/procurement: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com).

Please proceed with scheduling kickoff for Mar 11 10am PT. I have shared the DocuSign link for the signed envelope; legal has confirmed SOW countersigned.

Naomi
